facts.scope_guard: A sold-price address hit or regional average is discovery and context, not exact title identity, current condition or candidate valuation.

scope_guards: The June 2026 current-month release is incomplete by design and is not used alone as market-activity or inactivity evidence.
A Price Paid transaction records a sale lodged for registration and does not prove the current owner or current title state.
PPD exclusions mean a missing record is not evidence that no transfer or ownership change occurred.
Category A and Category B semantics remain distinct; a specific Category B transaction subtype is not guessed.
PAON, SAON, postcode and address matching do not establish title number or legal parcel geometry.
Freehold and leasehold duration codes are tenure attributes and not title identifiers or exact lease terms.
UK HPI regional and property-type aggregates are not parcel values, residual land values or candidate probabilities.
No score or promotion is written without exact transaction, title, current register, site identity and planning reconciliation.
